## log_call
`POST /webhook/log-call`

**Body:** `business_id`, `caller_number`, `intent`, `outcome`, `call_summary`, `booking_id` (optional), `duration_seconds` (optional)

`intent`/`outcome` are mapped onto the exact values the `calls` CHECK constraints allow (supabase/migrations/0002_multi_business.sql widens these to a superset of the original salon-only values) -- unrecognised values are rejected, never guessed. `business_id` is required and resolved before anything is written, and the booking-link patch is scoped to the same business so one business's call can never attach itself to another business's appointment. Failing to link a booking does not un-log the call; it is reported as `booking_link: "failed"`.

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "invalid_input", "logged": false, "status": "error", "call_id": null, "message": "The call log request was missing or malformed fields.", "details": $json.errors } }}
={{ { "error": "supabase_unavailable", "logged": false, "status": "error", "call_id": null, "message": "Could not reach Supabase, so the call was not logged." } }}
={{ { "error": "unknown_business", "logged": false, "status": "error", "call_id": null, "message": "No business is registered with that business_id." } }}

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ { "business_id": $('Normalize Business').first().json.business_id, "caller_number": $('Validate Input').first().json.caller_number, "intent": $('Validate Input').first().json.intent, "outcome": $('Validate Input').first().json.outcome, "summary": $('Validate Input').first().json.call_summary, "duration_seconds": $('Validate Input').first().json.duration_seconds, "started_at": $('Validate Input').first().json.started_at, "ended_at": $('Validate Input').first().json.ended_at } }}

parameters.responseBody: ={{ { "error": "call_not_logged", "logged": false, "status": "error", "call_id": null, "message": "The call record could not be written to Supabase." } }}
